labels.demo:review: Open pull request for a code-review demo
labels.demo:tests: Test generation or regression testing exercise

issues.title: Fix retired and lost status badge colors
issues.body:
The dashboard currently shows retired assets in green and lost assets in blue.

Start at `services/web/src/components/StatusBadge.astro`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Retired uses `bg-secondary`; lost uses `bg-danger`.
- Available remains green and assigned remains blue.
- Unknown status still falls back to gray.
- The web build passes.

A seeded open PR addresses this issue; use it for the review walkthrough. Do not merge until the demo is complete.

issues.title: Make CSV asset imports return row-level errors
issues.body:
`POST /imports/assets` stops the import when one downstream request fails. In `services/reporting-svc/app/routers/imports_.py`, the loop calls `raise_for_status()` without a row-level handler.

Reproduce with a CSV containing one valid row, one rejected row, and another valid row, using a mocked assets API.

## Acceptance criteria
- Validate required fields for every row.
- Continue after a rejected row; do not hide whole-service/network failures.
- Return imported/skipped counts and row-numbered errors.
- Keep malformed headers as HTTP 400.
- Add tests covering valid, rejected, and missing-field rows.

issues.title: Add meaningful reporting service tests
issues.body:
`services/reporting-svc/tests/` has no executable test suite. Add tests without starting other services.

## Acceptance criteria
- Cover warranty-window boundaries with deterministic dates and mocked assets.
- Cover utilization with zero assets and a representative status mix.
- Cover a valid CSV import using a mocked HTTP transport.
- Verify unavailable dependencies return a useful error.
- Run pytest in the Python CI job.

issues.title: Add combined type and status filters to the assets list
issues.body:
Extend the assets page and API so a presenter can filter hardware by both type and status, rather than searching a long mixed list.

Start at `services/assets-svc/Endpoints/AssetEndpoints.cs` and `services/web/src/pages/assets/index.astro`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Support type, status, and their intersection.
- Preserve existing search behavior and response shape.
- Preserve selected values in an accessible filter form.
- Display a useful empty state.
- Add endpoint tests for combined and empty filters.

issues.title: Replace concatenated Java SQL with bind parameters
issues.body:
This is an intentionally vulnerable educational scenario with synthetic data. Use the real CodeQL SQL injection alerts in the Security tab.

Start at `UserRepository.findByUsername` in auth-svc and `AuditRepository.search` in audit-svc.

## Acceptance criteria
- Replace concatenated SQL with prepared statements and bind parameters.
- Preserve normal lookup and search behavior.
- Add injection-regression tests without exposing the app publicly.
- Run Maven verification in both services.
- Verify CodeQL no longer reports the targeted paths on the fix branch.

Keep this open until the security demo; do not use real data or credentials.

issues.title: Modernize the Python report formatting helpers
issues.body:
The teaching module `services/reporting-svc/app/legacy/format_helpers.py` uses older formatting and path idioms.

## Acceptance criteria
- Use f-strings, pathlib, and explicit type hints where appropriate.
- Preserve public helper behavior and report response shapes.
- Add focused compatibility tests for dates and paths.
- Keep this a small Python-only modernization PR.

issues.title: Remove unreachable code from the demo report formatter
issues.body:
The standalone `services/reporting-svc/app/demo_quality.py` contains a second return that can never execute.

## Acceptance criteria
- Remove the dead statement without changing the public formatter result.
- Add focused tests for representative asset tags and statuses.
- Verify the real CodeQL unreachable-statement finding is resolved.
- Do not change normal reporting API behavior.

"""Standalone maintainability fixture; not imported by the reporting API."""


def format_asset_status(asset_tag: str, status: str) -> str:
    return f"{asset_tag}: {status}"
    return asset_tag  # Intentional unreachable statement for the quality demo.
